name: CrossEarth-SAR-Benchmarks
description: A collection of benchmarks built from SAR (synthetic aperture radar) imagery designed to evaluate cross-domain and cross-scene generalization for remote sensing tasks. It measures model performance on tasks such as classification, segmentation, and change detection across different geographic regions and sensor conditions. The benchmark emphasizes robustness to domain shifts common in SAR data and provides standardized splits and metrics.
reputation: An emerging benchmark in the SAR/remote-sensing community with growing interest for domain-generalization evaluation.
